placement_basis: Each pickup is interpolated from a segment in utown_core.json. No new latitude or longitude is introduced.
route_disclaimer: Walkway geometry is conceptual and unsurveyed. Pickups are game objects, not real campus points or navigation guidance.

items.title: Local Coordinate Frame
items.note: The scene uses a local east/north coordinate frame: east is +X and north is -Z.

items.title: Procedural Green
items.note: Town Green is an approximate outline. Its grass, trees and small props are procedural interpretations.

items.title: ERC Facade Study
items.note: The ERC glazing, sunshades and curved bay are estimated architectural studies, not measured construction drawings.

items.title: Schematic Walkway
items.note: This connector is a game-world proxy. It is not a surveyed pedestrian route or accessibility recommendation.

items.title: SRC Forum Study
items.note: The SRC forum disc and stacked connector volumes are provisional visual studies.

items.title: GIS Reference Layer
items.note: OpenStreetMap outlines are comparison references, not certified building footprints or verified 3D geometry.

items.title: Lighting Presets
items.note: Daylight, golden-hour, blue-hour and evening modes are artistic presets, not a solar or weather simulation.

items.title: Photo Review
items.note: Camera viewpoints support visual comparison, but heading, elevation and building alignment still need manual review.
